hook.name: LaunchGuardHook
hook.description: Manages token launches on zero-LP-fee Uniswap v4 pools, charging a 1% base-token fee on each swap. During the launch block it enforces an early-buyer allowlist, per-swap buy caps, and per-window hold caps, distributing collected fees to the creator, treasury, and token holders via a LiquidityLocker for any failed payouts.
